name: jeveloper
description: A System-1 reflex layer for Claude Code, powered by TypeSafe AI's Jev. Jev makes fast, cheap, typed decisions in the agent loop — route/gate tool calls, verify tool output, and judge task completion — so Claude reasons less and moves more reliably.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: API key for Jev decisions via OpenRouter (get one at openrouter.ai/keys). Stored securely in your OS keychain — never written to the repo or to settings.json. Without a key jeveloper stays inert (mock mode), so set this to make Jev actually run on every action.
